The globe is currently experiencing a Mass Energy Crisis.🌎🌍🌏  Here are some of the most impacted nations.

Cuba: 

Multiple nationwide blackouts, worst in years, due to fuel shortages & aging plants.

Australia: 

Critically low fuel stocks - 30 days.  Conservation pleas to avoid panic.

Philippines: 

Localized brownouts, 4-day work weeks for gov't, jet fuel risks.

Bangladesh: 

Fuel rationing, 5-hr rolling blackouts, early holidays & online classes.

Sri Lanka:

 4-day work week, strict petrol/diesel quotas (QR system), LPG shortages.

Pakistan:
 4-day work week, 50% fuel cuts for gov't, school closures.

India: 
Sharp price spikes, gas rationing signals, supply strains hitting daily life.

Egypt: 
Early mall/restaurant closures (9pm), billboard shutdowns to save power.

Kenya: 

Fuel rationing, halted exports as stocks run low.

Others on edge: Vietnam (dry pumps in places), Iraq (blackouts from lost Iranian gas), Japan/South Korea (reserves tapped).

Most of this is due to the Iran Conflict.

Yesterday's Refinery fire in TX isn't going to help.

The Philippines has become the first country to declare a national energy emergency as the US-Israeli war on Iran disrupts global oil supplies and sends prices soaring. Heavily dependent on imported fuel, it now faces an “imminent danger” of severe shortages, with reserves estimated at just weeks.

￭ President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. signed an executive order formally declaring the emergency and activating a nationwide response to stabilize energy supplies and shield the economy from rising fuel costs.

￭ As citizens already protest high gas prices, and a nationwide public transport strike continues against oil price hikes and US-Israeli aggression, authorities warn planes could be grounded, supply chains strained, and inflation worsened.

￭ The Philippines relies on coal for about 60% of its electricity generation, and is considering increasing its coal imports from Indonesia, its top supplier.

#VPol
